d1948154.text:
Greetings, $N,

Since the elemental wind spirits vanished, Zephras has been on a deadly precipice. The birds, the beasts, and even the roots beneath our feet call to us for aid.

Seek me out on the ground floor of the great tree here in Thendal Village. I will counsel and train you in the druidic arts.

-Xyton Silverwind, $C Trainer
d1948154.title: Folded Parchment

10666|43217733.name: Gordo
10666|43217733.text: Us is busy with important things!

10879|dc8290dc.name: Harbinger Balthazad
10879|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

1495|54c6960c.name: Deathguard Linnea
1495|54c6960c.text: Greetings, $C. Be wary as you travel east toward The Bulwark. Recent surveillance reports indicate increased Scourge activity in that area, so exercise caution.

1499|9cb5b422.name: Magistrate Sevren
1499|9cb5b422.text: Ah, you there!  I have tasks to give, and I need not waste time explaining their crucial nature.  Listen close.

1500|2af9e51a.name: Coleman Farthing
1500|2af9e51a.text:
I hope you're well, all things considered.

Sit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

1518|173903a2.name: Apothecary Johaan
1518|173903a2.text: The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.

1569|e2fc85be.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
1569|e2fc85be.text: No other race on Azeroth has suffered as much as our people, $c. To laugh in the face of death has become second nature for all of us.

1742|e7cb64ec.name: Deathguard Bartholomew
1742|e7cb64ec.text: There's a Bat Handler inside the Undercity.  Head south down the road out of Brill, then west at the T-intersection.  The Ruins of Lordaeron will be on your left.  Go into them and then down into the Undercity.  You can ask an Undercity Guardian there for further assistance.

1744|3ccea7ef.name: Deathguard Mort
1744|3ccea7ef.text: Blacksmith?  Nope, our last one turned back into one of those mindless Scourge.  There's one in the Undercity though to the south of town though.  Undercity is underneath the Ruins of Lordaeron, clever name, huh?  Just take the elevators down at the back of the ruins and then you can talk to one of the Undercity Guardians.  They should be able to point you in the right direction.

1744|ccfca24c.name: Deathguard Mort
1744|ccfca24c.text: If you're willing to risk yourself over the Light, then you can speak with Shari Stilwell near the stables. She can entertain your insanity.

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2210|d821d003.name: Deathguard Royann
2210|d821d003.text: Sorry friend, we don't have one of those here in Brill.  You'll have to head to the Undercity for that.  The Undercity is underneath the Ruins of Lordaeron to the south of Brill.  From the back of the ruins take the elevator down and then speak to one of the Undercity Guardians to find your way further.

2310|81663044.name: Jamie Nore
2310|81663044.text: I'm working on delicate matters of Horde intelligence. It would be best for us both if you did not disturb me.

244808|3f8410df.name: Aramis Hammerhand
244808|3f8410df.text: Welcome back to the light, friend. Do you require training?

246143|0c0fbd1e.name: Frightened Paladin
246143|0c0fbd1e.text:
No! No, no, no! This can't be. I'd rather be dead than Forsaken! 

<The Frightened $C raises her weapon, preparing to attack!>

246152|8754b3a4.name: Shari Stilwell
246152|8754b3a4.text: The light is a beacon that shines for all. What can I do for you, $c?

246349|da04ef25.name: Breton Samuels
246349|da04ef25.text:
If you've come seeking the fellowship of your fellow paladins, you've come to the right place. 

Welcome home.

246389|8e0ab317.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|8e0ab317.text:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

246389|b676ae27.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|b676ae27.text:
A little bit of a lot of things. Mostly I take the soft and weak and reshape them into hardened fighters once again.

It's a tough world out there, and even our own people mistrust us. We need to be tough and self-reliant if we are to fit into this "Horde" with the rest of our people.

246393|4b78c376.name: Jorin Croge
246393|4b78c376.text: There are many things lurking out there in the dark and the light is needed now more than ever. If only these poor souls could see that just because our world has changed doesn't mean we have to be the monsters that the living think we are.

246393|533ec9c8.name: Jorin Croge
246393|533ec9c8.text:
I make sure we are provisioned and that the scant resources we do have are distributed properly.

If this were a proper order, I'd be something of a quartermaster. Such as we are, however, I just do my best to make sure we are at least somewhat equipped to deal with the dangers all around us.

249363|595011e8.name: Yala Windwatcher
249363|595011e8.text:
The Wind Spirits have left us. 

Now, only mindless echoes remain. Be wary, however. These winds are neither kind, nor gentle.

251361|d8b5b5c2.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
251361|d8b5b5c2.text: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

251371|0102e6e2.name: Falorne Fallwind
251371|0102e6e2.text:
Greetings... Windshaper.

Those that call themselves members of the Windshapers find little common cause with most members of the High Order, as I'm sure you are aware. Outside the relative harmony of Thendal Grove, you may find that these divisions run deep indeed and rivalry can give way to outright violence, in some cases.

I'll say nothing more on this, save that you should mind your own business and do not interfere with the High Order's goals once you leave the grove. This is likely the only warning you'll receive.

251373|86bf8d52.name: Xyton Silverwind
251373|86bf8d52.text: If you have the aptitude for the druidic arts, I can train you.

251487|06790c88.name: Ventaari Brightwish
251487|06790c88.text:
Zephras is in a state of decline, unfortunately. The elemental wind spirits that brought us here to Skywall so many thousands of years ago have vanished, causing us to lose much of the magic on which we've depended for millennia.

The island itself is also dangerously unstable, and we've even lost contact with the other island provinces of the shen'dorei. The few Windshapers that still possess the gift of skysight have attempted to contact our brothers and sisters on the other islands, but we have had no response.

Many among us are worried that the shen'dorei here on Zephras are all that is left of our people.

251487|e6d43ba3.name: Ventaari Brightwish
251487|e6d43ba3.text:
The shen'dorei will always owe the spirits a debt for their aid, and the Windshapers have sworn an oath to repay that debt and restore things to the way they were before. Unfortunately, we are dangerously blind to what is happening around us within Skywall without the spirits to guide us.

The High Order are shortsighted and arrogant, just like their highborne ancestors. They seek to master and control the magic of this place. This is the very path that led us to flee from Kalimdor and reside here in the first place. I fear that much like our forebears their confidence has vastly outpaced their competence and the end result could be disastrous.

251487|e92a645e.name: Ventaari Brightwish
251487|e92a645e.text: What may I do for you, fellow windshaper?

251523|14e578ce.name: Constable Aonda
251523|14e578ce.text: <Constable Aonda wears an intense look on her face, clearly deep in thought.>

251902|f56638d6.name: Illaya Amberwind
251902|f56638d6.text:
Greetings, child. I am Illaya Amberwind and I am the Elder Windshaper here on Zephras Isle. It's always nice to meet young new faces that make their way down from the grove.

Don't let this old shaman hold you up, no doubt you've got many adventures to see to. Do feel free to stop by later if you'd like.

251905|3541aa81.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|3541aa81.text: If you need training as a cook, I have a few tips and tricks I could pass on! Ho ho! Throw on an apron and let's get started!

251906|6574e2ad.name: Teeri Wellwind
251906|6574e2ad.text: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

251991|8173c391.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
251991|8173c391.text:
The clothcraft of the Shen'dorei is a harmonious imitation of the flowing, carefree currents of the winds. While the spirits have left us, and I know not when I may see them dance once more... I find great comfort in my art, if only as a distraction.

I can teach you to work the cloth as well, if you'd like to learn?

251993|453a25ae.name: Indari Sunseam
251993|453a25ae.text: I can teach you to craft fine leather armor, if you have the aptitude.

254089|9cc50b7d.name: Coriella Calmbreeze
254089|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

257554|41088e5c.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
257554|41088e5c.text: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>

257655|9f0fb116.name: Deathguard Billmuth
257655|9f0fb116.text: <Deathguard Billmuth absentmindedly fidgets as he looks around nervously. He is clearly very uncomfortable being here.>

260093|58279558.name: Garen Largo
260093|58279558.text: Do you require training in the ways of the light?

263113|81449513.name: Myriaal Mistwake
263113|81449513.text: It can get boring up here, you know. I can only annoy that stuffy wretch Halaan so much before even that gets old.

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

265944|b48f927f.name: William Pickman
265944|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

267323|466d697a.name: Clarence Gillian
267323|466d697a.text:
Professions are divided between two main categories: primary and secondary.

You are limited to a maximum of two primary professions at a time. You can abandon your skill in a primary profession at any time; however, the wealth of knowledge you gathered for it will be lost. If you choose to return to your original profession, you will need to train from the basics and seek out recipes you previously acquired to refamiliarize yourself with them.

Secondary professions do not have such a limit. These skills tend to err towards self-sufficiency with your basic survival needs. You are free to train any or all of these, but may find fewer opportunities to turn a profit.

267323|83e0509a.name: Clarence Gillian
267323|83e0509a.text:
Hello, $N! Have you considered taking up a tradeskill?

I would be happy to answer any questions you might have, or point you toward the local trainers.

If this feels overwhelming, that's okay! You can always return here or visit trainers in capital cities to get started on your crafting journey at any time.

267354|ac69d40c.name: Black Skeletal Horse
267354|ac69d40c.text: <It snaps its teeth together, chomping at its bit.>

272526|bf500b92.name: Glix Xizzix
272526|bf500b92.text:
Yes, I am the renowned trader who magnanimously fed the uh, starving... children...? ...of the Undercity during the recent war with the Scourge. Yes, I am the visionary businessgob and logistical genius who single-handedly armed the resistance and allowed our Dark Lady to found her nation of smelly corpses... um, I mean, "Forsaken."

Yep, I'm him. Glix Xizzix. I'd be happy to sign an autograph. For a small fee, of course.

What am I doing here running a barbershop, you ask? Well I got one word for you, bub--diversification. You've got to keep your revenue streams diversified!

276067|2af62916.name: Angus Hammerhand
276067|2af62916.text:
It's my job to get the Paladins of Bandarion Keep set up with proper arms and armor. It's not much, but it's honest work.

I've got a thing or two for sale as well, should you need gear.

276110|2fc3ff64.name: Knight of Mourning
276110|2fc3ff64.text: My oath binds me to this place. What brings you here, to this light-forsaken place?

276797|866d28ab.name: Purple Skeletal Warhorse
276797|866d28ab.text: <The warhorse paws at the ground, causing the unholy flames around its chipped hoof to flicker with the motion.>

3549|2cec462d.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|2cec462d.text: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

4552|0c543544.name: Eunice Burch
4552|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4556|3dfe0528.name: Gordon Wendham
4556|3dfe0528.text: Greetings, and welcome.  I am not very good at smiling, but trust me; I am happy to serve you.

4596|49a65401.name: James Van Brunt
4596|49a65401.text: Want to be a smith? Want to forge blades to gut your foe? Hammers to crush his skull? Aye I can help, and gladly too if there is blood to be shed from it.

4605|1690954e.name: Basil Frye
4605|1690954e.text: I hope to one day forge weapons and armor from the bones of my enemies.

4605|3a5f002e.name: Basil Frye
4605|3a5f002e.text: You are not trying to kill the anvil with your hammer, you are trying to create a weapon to kill your foes with. Let me show you what you are doing wrong.

4731|52a47c36.name: Zachariah Post
4731|52a47c36.text:
I have little time to sit and have idle banter with you. If you desire one of my steeds, seek Velma over there, and she will teach you how to ride a skeletal steed.

I would not have you harming one of my beautiful horses with your ignorance.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5695|0a25fc55.name: Vance Undergloom
5695|0a25fc55.text: Greetings, traveler! Care to delve into the mysteries of the arcane? Hm?

5725|4be79dac.name: Deathguard Lundmark
5725|4be79dac.text: You'll find Innkeeper Renee inside the Gallows' End Tavern at the southeast end of the street running through town.

5759|a28d29e1.name: Nurse Neela
5759|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5819|88989ac8.name: Mirelle Tremayne
5819|88989ac8.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces are made and repaired here locally, though some are scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

354-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
354-accept.text:
The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades.  I used to work their mills...before the Plague.

When the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend.  We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.

The Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath.  And now they are minions of the Scourge!

Serve the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague.  Serve me by bringing me their remains.
354-accept.title: Deaths in the Family

354-progress.name: Coleman Farthing
354-progress.text: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
354-progress.title: Deaths in the Family

356-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-accept.text:
The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the Plaguelands are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.

Our success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.

Assist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.
356-accept.title: Rear Guard Patrol

357-accept.name: Bethor Iceshard
357-accept.text:
There is a lich who dwells on the island in Brightwater Lake to the north.  Although he is a free-willed Forsaken, he believes all other $R are Scourge slaves and has his minions attack anyone who approaches him.

But because he is Forsaken, the Queen will want him.  And if he is skilled in Necromancy, then his knowledge would be...quite useful to us.

To discover his identity and his talents, I must see his spellbook.  Steal into his camp and acquire it, then return to me.
357-accept.title: The Lich's Identity

358-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-accept.text:
The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.  

The bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies.  This cannot be allowed!

Your task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the Embalming Ichor that gives them life.
358-accept.title: Graverobbers

358-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-complete.text:
Expertly done, $N.  The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by our Apothecaries.  It may have secrets we can use against them.

As I said, well done.  But our struggle continues, and the conflict will surely offer you more chances to prove your worth to the Forsaken.
358-complete.title: Graverobbers

358-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-progress.text: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
358-progress.title: Graverobbers

359-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
359-accept.text:
I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east.

I must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal.  Our vigilance on the border to the Plaguelands must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here!

Travel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation.  Speak with Deathguard Linnea.  She has the information I need.
359-accept.title: Forsaken Duties

359-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
359-complete.text:
Magistrate Sevren wants a report?  Very well: the defenders at The Bulwark are holding the majority of the Scourge at bay, but some do slip through on occasion.

We have seen sporadic Scourge activity east of this station, with a concentration around the Balnir Farmstead.
359-complete.title: Forsaken Duties

360-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
360-accept.text:
Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you.  He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.

And if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.
360-accept.title: Return to the Magistrate

360-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
360-complete.text:
It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark.  The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.

But we will not give in.  He will not take us again!
360-complete.title: Return to the Magistrate

362-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
362-accept.text:
Devlin Agamand was the younger of two sons in the Agamand family, and in life the two could not be more different.  Thurman was tall and gentle while his younger brother was weak and sharp tongued.

When Agamand Mills fell to the Plague, I was not surprised to hear that Devlin was quick to succumb.  His mad chattering can still be heard near the road leading to the Agamand Mills.

I'm collecting the remains of the Agamands, and I want poor Devlin.  Find him, destroy him, and bring me his bones.
362-accept.title: The Haunted Mills

363-accept.name: Undertaker Mordo
363-accept.text:
About time you woke up. We were ready to toss you into the fire with the others, but it looks like you made it.

I am Mordo, the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell. And you are the Lich King's slave no more.

Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel at the base of the hill, he will tell you more of what you must know.
363-accept.title: Rude Awakening

363-complete.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
363-complete.text:
Another of the walking dead, hm? Must have been quite a shock, waking up in the crypt with only the cold and Mordo to greet you...

I see the confusion on your face. Let me try to explain our... situation... to you.

We have been freed from the control of the Lich King by our new leader, Lady Sylvanas. The Dark Lady guides us in our war against the hated Scourge and the holdouts of humanity who dog our every step.
363-complete.title: Rude Awakening

364-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
364-accept.text:
We Forsaken are at war with the Lich King's army of the Scourge: necromantically raised armies of the $r, foul beasts of the north, and tormented spectres.

The northern part of the village has become overrun with the Mindless Ones, and they must be destroyed. Destroy them, show them no mercy, our former brothers and sisters as they might be. The Fallen are nothing but The Lich King's slaves.
364-accept.title: The Mindless Ones

364-complete.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
364-complete.text:
It is unfortunate that the Scourge cannot be brought into the fold, their large numbers would be useful in the battles ahead.

But they will not join us, so we have no choice but to destroy them.
364-complete.title: The Mindless Ones

364-progress.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
364-progress.text: You will not go far in this new life if you are unable to kill even the weakest of zombies, $N. Do not return until you have success to report.
364-progress.title: The Mindless Ones

365-accept.name: Deathguard Simmer
365-accept.text:
What have we here?  You look like a fledgling $c.  If you hope to prove yourself to The Dark Lady, you need to learn the ways of The Forsaken.

To the west you'll find a farm.  Humans infest the land like mold on a rotting corpse.  And worse yet, the Scarlet Crusade patrols nearby from their tower.  Teach those scum a lesson and steal 10 of their precious pumpkins.

Once you have 10, take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.
365-accept.title: Fields of Grief

365-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
365-complete.text: You have performed your bidding well, young $c.  You are proving yourself to be quite an asset to The Dark Lady's army.
365-complete.title: Fields of Grief

365-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
365-progress.text: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents.  Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, $N?
365-progress.title: Fields of Grief

367-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-accept.text:
Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. The Dark Lady believes our knowledge coupled with the newfound magic will provide the key to Arthas's demise.  She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on Azeroth. This new disease will bring Arthas's Scourge Army to ruin.

My studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Bring to me 5 vials of darkhound blood so I can test my theory.
367-accept.title: A New Plague

367-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-complete.text: You have done well $N, and I thank you for your efforts.
367-complete.title: A New Plague

367-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-progress.text: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
367-progress.title: A New Plague

368-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-accept.text:
While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly. Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play. Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated.

I will need 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in the vicinity.  You will find the creatures along the coast to the north or to the west.
368-accept.title: A New Plague

370-accept.name: Executor Zygand
370-accept.text:
The strategic documents from Executor Arren contain all the details we need to wipe the human infestation from the lands.  According to the information, The Scarlet Crusade has assigned Captain Perrine and a brigade to the ruined tower southwest of Brill.

Kill Perrine along with 3 Zealots and 3 Missionaries and report back to me.
370-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

374-accept.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-accept.text:
Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing Scarlet Crusaders. Tirisfal Glades is crawling with them.

Varimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of Azeroth, the Human race, gets wiped into oblivion. Here in Tirisfal Glades we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: The Scarlet Crusade.

Venture forth and wage an offensive on the Scarlet Crusade, $c. Bring me back 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.
374-accept.title: Proof of Demise

375-accept.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-accept.text:
It's so cold, now.  The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent.  The Mindless State will be upon me soon.  But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady.  When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.

Now my hands shake from the chill.  If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread I could sew myself a blanket.  Help me, $N, so that I can continue to serve the cause.
375-accept.title: The Chill of Death

376-accept.name: Novice Elreth
376-accept.text:
My duties include tending to our wounded warriors, tailoring armor and clothes, and assisting Shadow Priest Sarvis with whatever else he might need.

From the look of it, you'll be enlisted in his service also... hunting the Mindless Ones, if I know his mind. Well, if you'd like to stay in one piece--and I've no doubt you do--perhaps I can help. I'm running out of paws and wings, and if you bring me some, I'll find some armor for you. You'll find a good number of wolves and bats to the south.
376-accept.title: The Damned

376-complete.name: Novice Elreth
376-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. This armor should help you out.

Hopefully, it should do you more good than the last one to wear it...
376-complete.title: The Damned

376-progress.name: Novice Elreth
376-progress.text: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.
376-progress.title: The Damned

380-accept.name: Executor Arren
380-accept.text:
One of our greatest struggles is obtaining the natural resources we need to survive. Gold was scarce even in the height of the Alliance's power.

There is a gold mine to the northwest that has been overrun with spiders. We need gold from the mine, but we can't very well get it while the spiders are crawling around in there. I've not much manpower to commit to the task, so we'll just have to do it little by little.

Get up there and see what you can do for us, $N.
380-accept.title: Night Web's Hollow

380-complete.name: Executor Arren
380-complete.text:
Hmm, well, it's a start. It'll take a few weeks or months to fully clean out the infestation. After that, we'll have to get down there with some torches to burn away the webbing.

You've done your duty well, $N, I'm sure I can find something else for you to do.
380-complete.title: Night Web's Hollow

381-accept.name: Executor Arren
381-accept.text:
You'll be happy to know we appear to be making progress in the mine, thanks in no small part to your efforts.  We can now turn our eyes to other concerns.

My scouts have reported that a detachment of the Scarlet Crusade is setting up a camp southeast of here. The Scarlet Crusade is a despicable organization that hunts us, and they will not rest until every $r--Lich King's Scourge or no--is destroyed. We must strike first!

Be careful, their unholy zeal makes them dangerous adversaries.
381-accept.title: The Scarlet Crusade

381-complete.name: Executor Arren
381-complete.text:
If only they listened to reason, eh, $N? Perhaps we could sit them down for reasonable discourse... ha!

Light-blinded fools.
381-complete.title: The Scarlet Crusade

381-progress.name: Executor Arren
381-progress.text: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.
381-progress.title: The Scarlet Crusade

382-accept.name: Executor Arren
382-accept.text:
Reports from my superiors in Brill indicate that an agent of the Scarlet Crusade was dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!

You're the most qualified person I have to send, $N. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.
382-accept.title: The Red Messenger

382-complete.name: Executor Arren
382-complete.text:
Hmm... Let's see what you've got...

<He begins to rifle through the documents you recovered.>

Some news of their exploits against us... Worthless. Scouting reports... New orders, "Continue to build up a camp near the ruined city..." Nothing we didn't know already... Ah, what's this? A map of the dispositions of some of their field commanders and agents! We can use this.
382-complete.title: The Red Messenger

383-accept.name: Executor Arren
383-accept.text:
These will need to be taken to my superior, Executor Zygand, in Brill. With this information, we'll be able to deal a decisive blow to the Scarlet Crusade. Your services have been useful here in Deathknell, but I need someone to deliver this to Zygand, and I believe he'll be able to find you more appropriate work.

Take the road north out of Deathknell. Soon after entering Tirisfal proper, you'll hit a crossroads. Take the eastern fork, and keep going east. You'll pass Cold Hearth Manor along the way.
383-accept.title: Vital Intelligence

383-complete.name: Executor Zygand
383-complete.text:
Yes, this is very good. You've done well in obtaining this information, $N. Hmm... names of the officers in the Tirisfal Glades...

Imagine the blow we could deal to the morale of those bloody zealots if we were to kill their leaders in one swift strike.
383-complete.title: Vital Intelligence

3901-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
3901-accept.text:
You've shown your potential to the Forsaken under normal circumstances $N - now let's see you under pressure.

The Rattlecage skeletons, more mindless minions of the Lich King, are a tougher foe than the zombies you have faced thus far.  Again, thin their numbers and prove yourself to the Forsaken.  Do not tarry - when you are done, speak to me again.
3901-accept.title: Rattling the Rattlecages

3901-complete.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
3901-complete.text:
I am finished with you, $N - you have shown yourself to be worthy of the freedom that you have been given.  Many will stand against you for what you have become, but know that no matter what they may try to do against us, we are free and will not be shackled again.

Take these and be on your way.  You have much to accomplish, $c.
3901-complete.title: Rattling the Rattlecages

3902-accept.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-accept.text:
You there!  If you're looking for something to make yourself useful, then listen up!

We need fresh out-of-the-ground recruits to head into Deathknell and search for any sort of useful equipment.  Most likely, they'll be in stacks of boxes.  We expect more recruits to be rising soon, and unless we want them to stumble about naked we had better get to scavenging!

Well get to work, you miserable bag of bones!  I'm not going to reward those without some hustle.
3902-accept.title: Scavenging Deathknell

3902-complete.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-complete.text: Great work $N, I knew you weren't useless.  Here - have one of the better items I've found out of the lots that have been collected so far.
3902-complete.title: Scavenging Deathknell

3902-progress.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-progress.text: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us?  There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside.  No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
3902-progress.title: Scavenging Deathknell

398-accept.name: Unknown
398-accept.text:
Wanted: Maggot Eye!

A foul beast, even by Gnoll standards, Maggot Eye has been sentenced to death for his crimes against The Forsaken.  This despicable villain has been stealing corpses for use by the Lich King's army.  Maggot Eye was last seen pillaging the lands near Garren's Haunt to the north of Brill.

The town of Brill hereby offers a reward to the capable soul who can carry out the execution.  Show Executor Zygand the villain's paw once the deed is done.

Mercy is for the weak.
398-accept.title: WANTED: Maggot Eye

398-complete.name: Executor Zygand
398-complete.text: Maggot Eye's dastardly acts have finally been avenged.  Maybe your acts of valor will send a clear message to those who wish to bring harm to our people.  On behalf of the town of Brill I thank you, $N.
398-complete.title: WANTED: Maggot Eye

404-accept.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-accept.text:
Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and have infested the area west of Brill, near the old bridge.

Go there and beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses you find.  Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws, and the Deathguards will reward you.
404-accept.title: A Putrid Task

404-complete.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-complete.text: Well done.  I regret not being there to see you smash those $r into rotting pulp!
404-complete.title: A Putrid Task

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

405-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
405-accept.text:
Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge.  You, $N, will be that agent.

Present these orders to Bethor.  He will then instruct you on your mission.  I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich.  And it will be dangerous.

So ready yourself, $C.  You must not fail.

You may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
405-accept.title: The Prodigal Lich

405-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-complete.text:
Ah, you are the agent sent by Magistrate Sevren.  Then yes, your business with me is crucial.

I trust Sevren has mustered someone suitable for my task...but we shall see.
405-complete.title: The Prodigal Lich

405-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-progress.text:
Greetings.  Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
405-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich

407-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
407-accept.text:
Harmless pumpkins, right?  Or so it would seem.  If we are to defeat Arthas's advances from the North and the Human infestation from the South we need to start realizing the full potential of our gift of undeath.

With a little ingenuity a simple pumpkin becomes an agent for our Dark Lady.  This pumpkin, laced with my latest formula, will prove to be quite a treat.

Yet another Scarlet Zealot has been captured and is being kept in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.  Take this pumpkin to the fool.
407-accept.title: Fields of Grief

407-complete.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-complete.text: By the Light!  Finally some food!  Sweet, sweet pumpkin. . . .
407-complete.title: Fields of Grief

407-progress.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-progress.text:
Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your. . .

. . .oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry. . .
407-progress.title: Fields of Grief

426-accept.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-accept.text:
The Scourge are trying to form a base at the Agamand Mills.  If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.

The orders have been given.  The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.

Go to the Mills.  Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.

To get to the Mills, follow the road west.  After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north.  When you see windmills, the battle will begin.
426-accept.title: The Mills Overrun

427-accept.name: Executor Zygand
427-accept.text:
The documents Executor Arren provided are just the break we needed in our battle with the wretched Scarlet Crusade.  We now know their exact locations throughout Tirisfal Glades.

But the Deathguard has larger concerns.  The Lich King's army grows in number each night.  We need someone with "initiative" like yourself to drive the Scarlet Crusade to the grave.

Prove to me you are capable of serving The Dark Lady by travelling west to the tower past the Solliden Farmstead and slay 10 Scarlet Warriors.
427-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

427-complete.name: Executor Zygand
427-complete.text: Most excellent, $c.  Your skill in the art of combat is undeniable.
427-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

445-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
445-accept.text:
Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas.  Surely you know this by now.

As a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.

Take these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.  Follow the roads to the south from Brill.  From the Undercity go southwest.
445-accept.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

5481-accept.name: Gordo
5481-accept.text:
Master want weeds. Us gots big hands and not good at picking. You help us and we not hurt you. Us need gloom weed. Many weeds around here and near road.

When you have gloom weed you take to Master Holland in Brill graveyard.
5481-accept.title: Gordo's Task

5481-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5481-complete.text:
What's this? Gloom weed?! I've no need for gloom weed! That mindless mass of flesh is out there picking daisies and convincing the Lady knows how many dupes like you into doing the same. No offense.

Very well, you're here now and that's all that matters. Since I'm not going to bother to try to explain things to that abomination how about you collect what I really need... doom weed!
5481-complete.title: Gordo's Task

5481-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5481-progress.text: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
5481-progress.title: Gordo's Task

5482-accept.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-accept.text:
So you can see the predicament that I'm in, $N. That thing is out there collecting the wrong weeds! I'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward.

It is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the Brill graveyard. Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.
5482-accept.title: Doom Weed

590-accept.name: Calvin Montague
590-accept.text:
What?

What?!

You want money? I don't owe you any money.

Letter? What letter? Oh, you wanna fight then? All right, mate... let's do this! Owe you any money...
590-accept.title: A Rogue's Deal

590-complete.name: Calvin Montague
590-complete.text:
Incredible! What skill!

Thought you'd be easy prey, $N. Got me good, you did.

Here's the coin I promised... not as much as I said it'd be, but that's on a count o' me lying to ya in the first place.
590-complete.title: A Rogue's Deal

6395-accept.name: Novice Elreth
6395-accept.text:
My friend Marla Fipps lived with her husband Samuel before the plague, but when the plague came Samuel succumbed and joined the Scourge's ranks.

Marla was spared an undeath only to die at the hands of her now mindless husband.  So strong was her love, however, that her last dying wish was to be buried with her beloved Samuel.

Samuel Fipps roams at a ruined camp along the road northeast of Deathknell.  Defeat him and grant Marla's wish: bury him at her grave, in the first row of our graveyard.
6395-accept.title: Marla's Last Wish

6395-complete.name: Novice Elreth
6395-complete.text: You have done a good deed today, $N.  Although our struggle against the Scourge continues, let us hope that Marla and Samuel will find peace together in their final resting place. As a token of my gratitude, please take one of these manuals I found.
6395-complete.title: Marla's Last Wish

8-accept.name: Calvin Montague
8-accept.text:
Hey, mate! Do a favor for a young man who's been fighting more than his fair share of mindless zombies and spiders?

I got this here letter that needs to go to Brill... to an innkeeper named Renee something-or-other. Don't really matter none what her last name is.

Anyway, it's a nice cozy little place full of victims of the plague trying to make their way in the world. And it be a great spot for you to rest too if the need arises. You should check it out... you do and I'll pay you well.
8-accept.title: A Rogue's Deal

8-complete.name: Innkeeper Renee
8-complete.text:
Oh? A letter? Wonderful news! I've been waiting on word from my dear old mother in Deathknell. Such a saint, she is. I wonder how she's holding up.

What? Too cheery? Not buying it, are you?

Well, get lost then... it's really no business who the letter's from anyway. Go on! Get lost!

Come back when you've got some coin to spend... loafer.

Next thing you know, you'll be coming back to rest after a long days adventure or some stupid thing like that.
8-complete.title: A Rogue's Deal

8-progress.name: Innkeeper Renee
8-progress.text:
Yes? Yes? What is it?

The forsaken; they certainly do have huge appetites. Make yourself at home... yes, rest those weary bones. My name's Renee if you need anything at all.
8-progress.title: A Rogue's Deal

86784-accept.name: Deathguard Bartholomew
86784-accept.text:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
86784-accept.title: Sticks and Bones

86784-complete.name: Eleanor Shackleton
86784-complete.text:
Extra firewood? That is always welcome. It will keep these old bones warm through the cold nights of the Glades.

I have a sling for collecting wood myself, so you might as well hang onto that basket.
86784-complete.title: Sticks and Bones

90902-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
90902-accept.text:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen $c to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
90902-accept.title: Rediscovering the Light

90902-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
90902-complete.text:
Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances. 

Be well and walk in the light once more, $c.
90902-complete.title: Rediscovering the Light

91208-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91208-accept.text:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened $c who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.
91208-accept.title: Coming to Terms

91208-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91208-complete.text:
Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end.

I will say a prayer to the light for her. Thank you for doing what must be done, $N.
91208-complete.title: Coming to Terms

91208-progress.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91208-progress.text: Coming to terms with this new life is not easy for any of us. For some it's simply more than they can bear.
91208-progress.title: Coming to Terms

91209-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91209-accept.text:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a $c traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.
91209-accept.title: Continue Your Training

91209-complete.name: Shari Stilwell
91209-complete.text:
Welcome aboard, $c. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training. 

When you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.

Go with the light, $c.
91209-complete.title: Continue Your Training

91282-accept.name: Shari Stilwell
91282-accept.text:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new $c order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
91282-accept.title: A Second Home

91282-complete.name: Breton Samuels
91282-complete.text: Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Bandarion Keep, brother.
91282-complete.title: A Second Home

91285-accept.name: Breton Samuels
91285-accept.text:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
91285-accept.title: Murlocs at the Gates

92460-accept.name: Ailee Farheart
92460-accept.text:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460-accept.title: Coming of Age

92460-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92460-complete.text:
Gale's greetings, $N. I am honored to bestow your coming of age relic today as you are recognized for the potential you bring to the shen'dorei. Our people have faced great hardship and persecution in our complex history.

Today you are given this relic which is one of many held by those before you. Someday when your ashes are scattered to the winds it will pass to another to continue our tradition.

As you take this relic with you know that the winds of home will be with you wherever you travel.
92460-complete.title: Coming of Age

92461-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92461-accept.text:
We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.

The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.

Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.
92461-accept.title: Harmony in Balance

92461-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92461-complete.text:
Thank you for your service to Zephras, young $c.

The vuldren are typically quite docile, but the animals that call Zephras home can sense when the magic on the winds is out of balance, which can lead to dangerous and unpredictable behavior if left unchecked.
92461-complete.title: Harmony in Balance

92462-accept.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92462-accept.text:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
92462-accept.title: Infestation Investigation

92462-complete.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92462-complete.text: Judging by the amount of bug entrails covering you, this must be quite the infestation.
92462-complete.title: Infestation Investigation

92463-accept.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92463-accept.text:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
92463-accept.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92463-complete.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92463-complete.text: Excellent work, $N. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.
92463-complete.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92464-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92464-accept.text:
Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.

Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them. 

My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
92464-accept.title: Elemental Unrest

92464-complete.name: Yala Windwatcher
92464-complete.text: Rorian sent you? Good. I could use your aid.
92464-complete.title: Elemental Unrest

92465-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92465-accept.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, $c?
92465-accept.title: Agitators

92465-complete.name: Yala Windwatcher
92465-complete.text: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.
92465-complete.title: Agitators

92469-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92469-accept.text:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469-accept.title: Return to Rorian

92469-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92469-complete.text:
This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.

You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, $N. Thank you.
92469-complete.title: Return to Rorian

92470-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-accept.text:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470-accept.title: Foul Matriarch

92470-complete.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-complete.text: Very well done. You've felled beasts and laid low cultist interlopers. You have shown great promise but your path must soon take you beyond the relative safety of Thendal Village.
92470-complete.title: Foul Matriarch

92470-progress.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-progress.text: What I ask of you is not easy, but you must be prepared for much greater challenges if you are to survive long enough to be of service to Zephras Isle.
92470-progress.title: Foul Matriarch

92471-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92471-accept.text:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
92471-accept.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92471-complete.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92471-complete.text:
Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age.

So tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle?
92471-complete.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92472-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92472-accept.text:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
92472-accept.title: The Next Step

92472-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92472-complete.text: Aetheen sent you, then? I'll confess, you don't look like much to me, but Shen'dar Village won't turn down willing aid, much less aid sent from Elder Aetheen herself.
92472-complete.title: The Next Step

92473-accept.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-accept.text:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473-accept.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92473-complete.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-complete.text: Well done, $c. The Rangers of the Grove are in your debt.
92473-complete.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92473-progress.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-progress.text: The ursera have grown far more aggressive of late. I wonder what has changed to cause this shift in behavior?
92473-progress.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92474-accept.name: Myriaal Mistwake
92474-accept.text:
Well hello there, $N! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
92474-accept.title: Falling With Style

92474-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92474-complete.text:
How many times do I need to tell Myriaal not to encourage others to make reckless usage of our $r gifts!

That being said, I suppose that a little bit of practice in the relative safety of the village is... acceptable.

In the future I'd simply suggest you to use your ability judiciously. You do not want to exhaust your magic thoughtlessly and then not be able to use it when you truly need it.
92474-complete.title: Falling With Style

92485-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92485-accept.text:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485-accept.title: A Student of Nature

92485-complete.name: Xyton Silverwind
92485-complete.text:
The flora and fauna of Zephras Isle represent a rich tapestry of vibrant life. The ecosystem requires constant balance to maintain the harmony of nature, and we druids are the keepers of that balance. I see much potential in you, but this path is not an easy one, and you will need guidance as you grow in strength as a student of the fang, the claw, the feather, and the branch. 

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
92485-complete.title: A Student of Nature

92485-progress.name: Xyton Silverwind
92485-progress.text: Greetings, I am Xyton Silverwind, keeper of druidic lore.
92485-progress.title: A Student of Nature

92514-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92514-accept.text:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
92514-accept.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

92514-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92514-complete.text:
Checked in with Illaya then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Everyone here is well aware that we've got bigger problems than their quibbles.

Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands and I've got a bandit problem that I was hoping you could help me with.
92514-complete.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

92515-accept.name: Indari Sunseam
92515-accept.text:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
92515-accept.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92516-accept.name: Teeri Wellwind
92516-accept.text: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.
92516-accept.title: Hippogryph Harassment

92517-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92517-accept.text:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
92517-accept.title: The Criminal Element

92544-accept.name: Hanaa Nightwind
92544-accept.text:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
92544-accept.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

92544-complete.name: Hanaa Nightwind
92544-complete.text:
It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon. 

Thank you, $c. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.
92544-complete.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

92553-accept.name: Zerril Softbreeze
92553-accept.text:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
92553-accept.title: Restocking the Larders

92595-accept.name: Illaya Amberwind
92595-accept.text:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift. 

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92595-accept.title: The Windshapers

92595-complete.name: Illaya Amberwind
92595-complete.text:
I think you now understand how important the mission of the Windshapers is. Every soul who commands the skysight is of vital importance if we hope to establish dialogue with the spirits of the winds once again.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and the uncertainty of our safety here in Skywall, it is our responsibility as Windshapers to use our gifts to save our home and ensure that the Shen'dorei can survive these trying times.
92595-complete.title: The Windshapers

92598-accept.name: Ventaari Brightwish
92598-accept.text:
As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.
92598-accept.title: The Gift of Skysight

92598-complete.name: Ventaari Brightwish
92598-complete.text:
Like a muscle, your skysight must be exercised if you hope to grow stronger in the gift. Leveraging your skysight to bridge the distance between the mortal and the spiritual may prove invaluable to you in your adventures.

You'd do well to remember what you've learned here today. Our ability to use our gifts to hear what the elements tell us could be the key to our survival.
92598-complete.title: The Gift of Skysight

93318-accept.name: Unknown
93318-accept.text:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.
93318-accept.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93319-accept.name: Teeri Wellwind
93319-accept.text:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?
93319-accept.title: Pilfered Windstones

93552-accept.name: Dalia the Collector
93552-accept.text:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?
93552-accept.title: Harvesting Windstones

93552-complete.name: Dalia the Collector
93552-complete.text:
Thank you very much for these. As elves we all have a deep connection to magic and these windstones are becoming more and more precious as the magic imbued into this island by the great anchor pylons continues to fade. 

Windstones aren't the only beneficial thing you can harvest from the land. Please, take one of these manuals.
93552-complete.title: Harvesting Windstones

93951-accept.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
93951-accept.text:
The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many $r love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.
93951-accept.title: A Little Beauty

94411-accept.name: Illaya Amberwind
94411-accept.text:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.
94411-accept.title: Meddlesome Mages

94414-accept.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
94414-accept.text:
Greetings, young $N. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
94414-accept.title: The Anchors of Zephras

94414-complete.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
94414-complete.text: Thank you for taking a moment to share this with me. I will continue to watch over the grove, and ponder on the state of our homeland.
94414-complete.title: The Anchors of Zephras

94414-progress.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
94414-progress.text:
My gift is simple, and mundane. I cannot peer between worlds such as those with the skysight, nor can I draw upon the magic of the leylines beneath Zephras like others can. But a gift it remains and I am grateful to have it.

Appreciation of what you have is the key to happiness. Yearning for what you may have, or what you have lost, only leads to despair.
94414-progress.title: The Anchors of Zephras

95314-accept.name: Carolai Anise
95314-accept.text:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
95314-accept.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

96101-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96101-progress.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-progress.text: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors is critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
96101-progress.title: The Great Outdoors

96607-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
96607-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96607-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96607-complete.name: Eleanor Shackleton
96607-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96607-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96638-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
96638-accept.text:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
96638-accept.title: The Adventurer

96656-accept.name: Executor Arren
96656-accept.text:
$N, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.
96656-accept.title: The Adventurer

96656-complete.name: Eleanor Shackleton
96656-complete.text:
I'm not affiliated with the Scarlet Crusade, if you couldn't tell. I'm just an adventurer stopping by before my next venture into the wilderness.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96656-complete.title: The Adventurer

96658-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
96658-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96658-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96658-complete.name: William Pickman
96658-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96658-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97558-accept.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-accept.text:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an $r heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, $N. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
97558-accept.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97952-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
97952-accept.text:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97952-accept.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97955-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
97955-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97955-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97955-complete.name: Nurse Neela
97955-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97955-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97959-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
97959-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97959-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

98389-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98389-accept.text:
If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.

This we have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

Then they will see our nature.
98389-accept.title: A Light in the Darkness

98389-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98389-complete.text:
May this help Executor Arren and so many others see our true nature. Much like in our past lives, we live to serve our people--to protect them with the gifts the Light provides us.

They will see in time that we are just as valuable to the Dark Lady's plans as any other.

Light be with you.
98389-complete.title: A Light in the Darkness

98389-progress.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98389-progress.text: Have you freed the poor, unfortunate souls trapped in that cave?
98389-progress.title: A Light in the Darkness

98601-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
98601-accept.text:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to a $c like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
98601-accept.title: A Difficult Path

98601-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98601-complete.text: Your training can now begin in earnest, $c. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.
98601-complete.title: A Difficult Path

99134-accept.name: Executor Zygand
99134-accept.text:
You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--$N, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
99134-accept.title: Discipline

99134-complete.name: Executor Zygand
99134-complete.text:
There are precious few delights afforded to us in death. Thankfully, pain is chief among them.

You please me this day, and therefore you please the Dark Lady. Perhaps you can be of further use.
99134-complete.title: Discipline

99141-accept.name: Executor Zygand
99141-accept.text:
Make no mistake, $c--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.

Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
99141-accept.title: Patience
